title: Levuvo SF backlog (D1-D3)
description: backlog.json in the project repo root. Written only by the factory (GD3.1); the order of entries is the priority, changed only by the human in the UI (GD3.2). Read by agents and the UI.

version.description: Incremented by the factory with every change; a reorder from the UI is accepted only for the version the UI showed.

entries.description: Order = priority, top first. New entries are appended at the end.

ref.description: Feature ID (features.json, spec in features/<ID>/) or report ID (bugs/<ID>/). Unique in the backlog.

summary.description: Short description, one or two sentences.

pr.description: Link to the merged PR; required when done.

reason.description: Why the human discarded the entry; required when discarded.
